jobOpening.description:
Keep Operations Moving – Join PRC-Saltillo as a Shipping Clerk


This is a hands-on role where accuracy, organization, and teamwork come together. Are you someone who likes staying busy, keeping things running smoothly, and making sure orders are accurate and on time? This position plays a key role in supporting daily operations across the company.

The Shipping Clerk is responsible for processing and preparing outgoing shipments, ensuring orders are accurate, complete, and delivered on time. This role works closely with multiple departments, handles shipping systems and documentation, and helps maintain an organized, efficient shipping environment.

Go to our website to apply https://prentkeromich.bamboohr.com/careers

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Mission-Driven Work: Support operations that help deliver communication solutions to those who need them.
Hands-On Role: Stay active with a mix of shipping, inventory, and coordination tasks.
Team Environment: Work closely with internal teams and external partners to keep things moving.
Growth Opportunities: Build your skills with shipping systems, process improvements, and potential leadership responsibilities.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Processes shipments using ERP and carrier systems, including creating labels and tracking deliveries.
  • Prepares and packages orders, ensuring all items, accessories, and documentation are accurate and complete.
  • Supports rush and priority shipments across multiple departments.
  • Monitors finished goods to ensure quality and completeness before shipping.
  • Assists with incoming deliveries and maintains accurate shipping records.
  • Prepares documentation for domestic and international shipments.
  • Maintains inventory of shipping supplies and performs regular inventory checks.
  • Keeps the shipping and warehouse areas clean and organized.
  • Provides high-quality service to both internal teams and external partners.


Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organization
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities
  • Team-oriented with strong communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision
  • Adaptable and flexible in a fast-paced environment
  • Basic computer skills (Clerk) / Proficient computer skills (Lead)
  • Comfortable using equipment such as pallet jacks (training provided)
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and quality
